scientific_integrity.claims: The analytical proof, not finite experiments, establishes universal optimality and uniqueness.
scientific_integrity.first_public_date_basis: First date printed in publicly available MTNS 2006 proceedings dated July 24--28, 2006; an exact original electronic-upload instant is not asserted.
scientific_integrity.published_framework_acknowledged: General minimax-effective-resistance convex SDP formulation was already stated in Ghosh--Boyd--Saberi 2006.

scientific_limitations: Finite spiders only; no cycles, multiple branching junctions, nonlinear or capped edge prices; objective is maximum effective resistance, not total resistance or spectral gap. No independent mathematical validation.
title: Sharp arm-dominance transition for resistance-diameter design on spider trees
